blocks.title: A Moroccan henna like grandmother's – only more beautiful
blocks.text: The henna is the night the family wraps itself around the bride. We keep the ritual, the colours and the songs, and dress them in today's design.

blocks.title: From set-up to the last zaghrouta
blocks.text: We arrive early, build the bridal corner and the tables, dress you and your family, and guide the entrances and the ceremony. All you have to do is be there.

blocks.title: We meet, try on, plan
blocks.text: It all starts with a meeting at the studio: we get to know each other, try on outfits and build the evening together. Prefer a video call? That works too.

events.title: Recent henna nights
events.text: Every evening is different, every family has its own story. Hundreds more moments are waiting on Instagram.

about.title: With God's help, we'll do it and succeed
about.p1: Kineret henna events was born from a love of Moroccan tradition and the moments it creates: the bride in her kaftan, the zaghroutas, the family gathered around the henna tray.
about.p2: Outfits and complete productions leave our studio with one goal: that your evening feels exactly the way you dreamed it.

reviews.title: “I stepped into a Moroccan fairy tale”

faq.title: Before you lock in a date

items.q: How far in advance should we book?
items.a: As soon as you have a wedding date. Dates go fast in wedding season, so it's best to check availability as early as possible.
Tell us where the event will take place and we'll check availability and travel together.
It depends on the package and the size of the family. At our meeting we choose the outfits for the bride, the groom and the family together.

items.q: Are the outfits rented or sold?
items.a: The outfits come as part of the production for the henna night. Have a question about a specific piece? Write to us.

items.q: Can I come for a fitting?
items.a: Of course. Fittings take place at the studio, by appointment, so every outfit fits you perfectly.

items.q: How do we hold a date?
items.a: After the meeting and choosing a package, the date is held with a deposit. We'll settle all the details together.
